viewer: Workers whose paycheck withholding produces a federal tax refund of about $3,000 every spring.
decision: Keep over-withholding for a $3,000 refund, or adjust withholding for bigger paychecks instead?

title: Your $3,000 Tax Refund: What Is It Really Costing You?
